title: Taurospongins B and C, new acetylenic fatty acid derivatives possessing a taurine amide residue from a marine sponge of the family Spongiidae

sections.abstract: Two new acetylenic fatty acid derivatives possessing a taurine amide residue, taurospongins B (1) and C (2), have been isolated from an Okinawan marine sponge of the family Spongiidae.
